newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Int'l in HK$311 mln assets deal.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Int'l in HK$311 mln assets deal.

text.p: Optical products distributor Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would buy two properties in China's Shenzhen and Zhuhai for a total HK$311.1 million.
The company said it had agreed to buy property, including basement two to level three of Hua Li Garden in Shenzhen, from parent Shenzhen Building Materials Industrial Group Co for HK$226.10 million
About HK$113.05 million will be paid in cash and the balance of HK$113.05 million will be satisfied by an issue of 231.75 million new shares at HK$0.4878 each, it said.
The company's shares closed at HK$0.61 on Friday.
Hua Li Garden is a development comprising two 25-storey residential blocks on a three-level shopping podium and a basement carpark in Shenzhen.

The company also said it had agreed to buy 121 residential units and 10 dulpex units of a commercial and residential development, Yong He Garden, in Zhuhai from third party Zhuhai Yong He Realty Development Co for HK$85 million.
It said about HK$5.00 million would be paid in cash and the balance of HK$80 million would pay by an issue of 164 million new shares at HK$0.4878 each.
On completion of the deals, the parent's stake in the company will be diluted to 60.18 percent from 60.55 percent, while Zhuhai Yong Ye Realty will hold 7.72 percent of the company.
Shenzhen International said the purchases will allow the company to enjoy additional recurrent income sources and would enhance the asset base of the company.
